origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 周, qui donnait le son mais se lit zhōu. C'est accorder, harmoniser. Lu tiáo, « régler, ajuster » ; lu diào, « muter », et aussi l'air d'une mélodie.
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 周, which gave the sound but is read zhōu. It means to bring into tune, to harmonise. Read tiáo, “to adjust”; read diào, “to transfer”, and also the tune of a melody.

phrase.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ tā diào dào Běijīng le.
phrase.en: The company transferred him to Beijing.
